Our Story

They can't ask for better.
So we built it for them.

Every product at Furvora exists for one reason, because your pet deserves more than what most brands offer.

“Your pet will never complain. They will never return something. They will never tell you it hurts or it’s too rough or it’s not what they needed. They will simply endure it, and love you anyway.”

A Letter to Every Pet

Dear Milo, Luna, Bear, Bella, and every pet who has ever been loved,

You have never asked for much. A warm place to sleep. A meal when you’re hungry. A hand to rest your head on after a long day of simply being alive. You give everything, your loyalty, your joy, your unconditional presence, and you ask for nothing in return.

But you deserve more than nothing. You deserve comfort that was actually designed for you. Materials that are gentle on your skin, your fur, your paws. Products that someone thought about carefully, not because it was profitable, but because you matter.

You can’t walk into a shop and choose what feels right. You can’t read a label or leave a review. You rely entirely on the person who loves you. And they rely on us.

So this is our promise to you, we will never forget who we are really building for.

With love,
Furvora

How It Started

Giorgio watched his dog push the bed aside and sleep on the floor instead.

It was a Tuesday evening. He had spent €40 on what the packaging called a “premium comfort bed.” His dog, Marco, sniffed it once, and went back to the cold floor. Not because Marco was fussy. Because the bed wasn’t good enough.

That moment stayed with Giorgio. He started looking more closely at the pet products around him, the cheap materials disguised by bright packaging, the generic designs copied from one supplier to the next, the complete absence of genuine thought for the animal actually using the product.

He didn’t set out to start a brand. He set out to find something better. When he couldn’t, he built it himself. That’s what Furvora is, the answer to a question that bothered him so much he couldn’t ignore it any longer.

The Furvora Promise
We will never

Prioritise how a product looks over how it feels for your pet.

Use materials we wouldn’t be comfortable putting against our own skin.

Ship something we wouldn’t give to Marco.

We will always

Design with the animal in mind first, the aesthetic second.

Stand behind everything we sell with a genuine guarantee.

Remember that behind every order is a pet who trusts someone completely.

1 in 3

pets never regularly uses the bed their owner buys them, not because they don’t want comfort, but because the product wasn’t designed with them in mind.

We built Furvora to change that number.

Built with intention. Designed with care. Made for the ones who can’t ask for better.

Giorgio
Founder, Furvora
